thread:
maria-sales: Hi team — quick sync with Pivotal Health (Tom). They want a 4-week POC to validate clinical summarization + PHI handling. Initial asks: DPA + SOC2 artifacts, pen-test schedule, and success criteria. Can we scope?

ajay-se: Got it. Two questions: will they use hosted API or Dedicated/Private? That affects timeline and artifact access.

tom-pivotal: We're aiming for hosted first, but if security requires, we can move to Dedicated. Primary constraint: no PHI leaves their region; data residency in us-east-1.

leah-security: @maria @ajay quick checklist: 1) DPA signed, 2) SOC2 Type II report + SOC2 bridge letter, 3) Written subprocessor list, 4) Data retention and deletion SLA, 5) Pen-test windows and scope, 6) KMS/HSM options, 7) SSO & SCIM. Can we provide all for hosted?

ajay-se: For hosted we can provide SOC2 Type II, SOC2 bridge, DPA, subprocessors list, encryption at rest/in-transit, and audit logs. KMS customer-managed keys are available on Dedicated/Private only. We'll document the data flow and deletion APIs for the POC.

olivia-legal: We'll need to confirm standard DPA covers PHI for a POC. If Tom's org needs HIPAA BAA, that'll bump legal review. Tom, do you need a BAA now or is the POC covered under limited transfer?

tom-pivotal: They want HIPAA-level assurances; will likely need a BAA before any PHI is ingested. For the test data we can use de-identified records if that helps move faster.

maria-sales: Proposal: week 0 — paperwork (DPA + routing to legal), week 1 — infra + sample dataset ingestion (de-identified), week 2 — run evals and iterate prompts, week 3 — stress/latency tests + replay, week 4 — final demo + handoff. Is that realistic?

ajay-se: Yes. For success criteria let's propose specific metrics: 1) Clinical summary accuracy: F1 >= 0.82 on annotated test set, 2) Hallucination rate < 3% (critical), 3) Average generation latency <= 400ms (p50) on 512-token context, 4) Throughput 12 rps sustained, 5) No data exfil incidents & retention/delete verification.

leah-security: Add: logs retention window (we can provide 90 days by default), and provide an audit plan to show access controls — who accessed what during POC. Also need to know whether customer will allow a scoped pen-test against the hosted endpoint.

tom-pivotal: Pen-test: they will only allow a vendor-run test after DPA and BAA. They can do a black-box webapp-level test; not OK with probing underlying infra. Is a scoped penetration test on the API acceptable?

ajay-se: We usually allow vendor pen-tests against customer-specific endpoints in Dedicated/Private. For hosted, we can coordinate a staged test with our security team and production tenant isolation; it'll take ~3 weeks to schedule. Recommend de-identified test data for the POC to avoid BAA delay.

maria-sales: Pricing question from Tom: What's the POC pricing? They expect a short-term flat fee or usage credit. Also want cost projections for expected QPS if rolling to 100k calls/day.

ajay-se: For a 4-week POC we typically offer a $10k credit + reduced per-token pilot pricing. For 100k calls/day we should model Dedicated reserved capacity. I'll prepare a TCO sketch (tokens/calls, batching, quantization) and attach after this thread.

olivia-legal: I'll start a pre-review of the DPA for PHI language. If the POC uses de-identified data and no BAA, we can likely proceed faster. If they require BAA, allow 2–3 weeks for legal.

leah-security: On artifacts, I'll attach where we host SOC2 and the standard pen-test policy. Note: SOC2 report is sensitive — we'll share via secure link. Also need to confirm whether customer requires data processing location guarantees beyond region.

maria-sales: Ajay — can you post a short evaluation plan / sample prompts we plan to run so Tom can sign off? Keep it lightweight.

ajay-se: Sure. Sample eval plan: 
``` 
- Dataset: 300 anonymized clinical notes + 50 edge-case notes
- Prompts: system: "Summarize key clinical findings and recommended actions"
  user: "Patient note: <note>"
- Evals: automated F1 on entity extraction, human review for hallucinations on 50 notes
- Pass thresholds: F1 >= 0.82, hallucination rate < 3%
``` 
I'll also include a prompt example: `Summarize the patient's hospital course in 3 bullets, list unresolved problems, and recommended next steps.`

tom-pivotal: That looks good. If we use de-identified notes with realistic edge cases it should be representative. Also request that metadata logs for requests are retained for 90 days for audit.

ajay-se: Noted. We'll provide request/response logs (no raw input persistence beyond retention window) and an API to trigger deletion for the POC dataset.

leah-security: Action items: 1) maria to collect customer legal contact, 2) olivia to start DPA/BAA triage, 3) ajay to share eval plan + TCO, 4) security to confirm pen-test windows and artifact sharing method.

maria-sales: I'll loop in @olivia-legal and @leah-security with Tom's legal ops. Tom — can you share the legal contact and preferred data residency form?

tom-pivotal: Sending contact now via DM. Also uploading a sample de-id dataset to the shared drive after this thread.

deploy-bot: Notice: onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/1832509876-pivotal-poc (owner: maria-sales)

maria-sales: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule a kick-off EOD Monday if legal triage is on track. :thumbsup:
